summary:
Implementation plan for AdaptiFi - Ambient & Adaptive Accessibility Health Utility Android application.
The plan covers:
1. Architectural foundation, styling tokens, and Material 3 design system matching the provided mockups and brand guidelines.
2. 4 main navigation tabs (Home, AR Navigation, Haptic Band, Sensing Engine) with bottom navigation and edge-to-edge layout.
3. Interactive 5-step Adapted Booking flow with real speech/voice dictation simulation, step progression, and the side-by-side Unadapted Legacy comparison view highlighting 8 accessibility barriers.
4. AR Navigation simulation with live camera/concourse canvas, 3D turn direction chevrons, spatial signage detection reticle, audio replay, and real Android vibrator haptics.
5. Haptic Band calibration suite with real Android HapticFeedback/Vibrator patterns, audio tone generation, interactive test triggers, and connection states.
6. Sensing Engine telemetry diagnostics featuring dynamic barrier probabilities, animated equalizer bars, and real-time heuristics.
